method: Existing drawn motion poses retained. Stationary body pixels retained identically at fixed coordinates; wood source phases share a small uniform size correction. No new motion synthesis.

key.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Draw exactly TWO harvesting animation key poses of the exact reference dew-covered grass sprite, in TWO equal square cells side by side on transparent RGBA. The original is the absolute authority for style, layout, plant shape, colors, proportions and THREE attached dew drops. Preserve the same placement and scale within each square including the original empty margins: rooted base at about x=50%, y=73%; large droplet atop tall left-curving blade, small drop on low left blade, medium drop on right blade, and short bare blade pointing right. LEFT cell: peak contact as an unseen tiny gatherer brushes the tall central blade a little toward the viewer's right and down, flexing the blade naturally while its root remains fixed. The large droplet follows with a slight lag, still attached to the tip, gently elongating under its own weight, volume preserved. The smaller blades react later and much less. RIGHT cell: weak opposite recoil, tall blade returning toward its neutral position with the large drop gently wobbling and becoming rounder; small blades lag and settle. This should feel like someone carefully parting the blades to gather dew. The base is identical in position and shape across both poses. Preserve fine natural curve attachments, translucent blue-gold liquid with reference highlights and smooth original green painted leaf shading. No added blades or drops, no drop detachment, splashes, particles, sparkles, creature, hand, tool, camera motion, labels, grid or checkerboard. Actual drawn animation artwork; complete sprite silhouette in each square with no clipping.

approach.prompt: Draw exactly TWO adjacent approach frames before the LEFT key pose of the referenced dew-grass harvesting animation, side by side in equal square cells, true transparent alpha. Preserve the SAME four grass blades and THREE attached drops, exact smooth painted green/blue-gold style, fine contour, root position, proportions and scale. Frame 1: large drop is almost round, tall blade only just beginning to flex from an unseen gentle brush; small blades still nearly neutral. Frame 2: tall blade is halfway toward left reference's contact bend, large drop mildly elongating and lagging behind the blade; smaller blades only starting to respond. The root stays still at the same local coordinate. Complete natural leaf attachments and attached droplet necks. Restrained subtle motion, same drop volume, no detachment, no splashes, no added blades, no sparkle, no face or hands or tools. Equal blank margins, no background, glow, text, grid or borders. Preserve reference artwork identity; draw missing poses.

release.prompt: Draw TWO adjacent release frames BETWEEN the two checked dew-grass key poses in reference. Two equal square cells side by side, actual transparent RGBA. Match EXACT same plant, four grass blades, three attached dew drops, root base position, overall scale, fine contours and original smooth painted green/blue-gold palette. Left output: one-third after left contact key toward right return key, tall blade gently releasing and large droplet starting to shorten from stretched to round. Right output: two-thirds toward right key, large drop nearly round and other small blades slightly lagging. Natural elastic leaf movement with root firmly stationary, subtle delayed liquid wobble. All drop volumes and attachments preserved. No fresh leaf, extra drops, splash, hands, creatures, particles, glow, background, labels, text or grid. The two drawings must be extremely close neighbors of existing keys, not a redesign.

settle.prompt: Draw TWO very close final settling frames of the exact dew-grass resource. Image 1 is ORIGINAL neutral design and final target; image 2 contains checked contact/recoil poses. Two equal square cells side by side, genuine transparent RGBA outside the silhouettes. Left output: just after image 2 RIGHT recoil, gently settling halfway back to image 1 original; right output: almost identical to image 1 original pose, the last tiny liquid wobble subsiding. Four grass blades, exactly three attached dew drops in same sizes and locations as original, original root base shape. Tall blade naturally curves left again with round large hanging drop, short left blade small drop, right curved blade medium drop, bare short right blade. Fixed root, equal overall size and equal blank margins across both cells. Preserve original fine green outlines, smooth hand-painted shading, translucent blue-gold drops, no extra glow or colored fringe. No added leaves, droplets, sparks, background, text, grid, hands or tools. Very subtle remaining motion with volume preserved. Output drawn source frames only.
